versions.changelog: Added frontmatter permissions (bash, curl). Added disclosure that prompts and media are sent to external paid APIs. Added billing risk and privacy warnings. Added per-section data transmission notes. Updated description for search discoverability.

AI Content Creator 1.0.0 — initial release

- Launches an all-in-one content creation agent supporting blog posts, social media, newsletters, scripts, product copy, images, video, and voiceovers.
- Provides 14 endpoints for text, image, video, audio, research, and utility tasks, all accessible via x402 micropayments.
- Includes detailed content workflows for blogs, social posts, newsletters, podcasts, video, product pages, and content repurposing.
- Supports advanced web research, content extraction, and multi-modal AI generation in a single integrated workflow.
- Offers command-line usage examples for each endpoint, making integration and automation straightforward.
